children: Atlas Energy Solutions announced equipment purchase agreements for 611 MW of Caterpillar generation capacity, including 283 MW supported by cost reimbursement agreements with a leading frontier AI lab.
ProjectCo entered incremental purchase commitments for 283 MW of Caterpillar equipment for a specific data center project.
Two cost reimbursement agreements with a leading frontier AI lab allocate equipment to that customer and facilitate near-term financing.
First reimbursement supports balance-of-plant gear, emissions controls, distribution, and battery storage tied to existing GFA orders.
Atlas also executed a purchase agreement for 328 MW of generating capacity consistent with 2027 GFA delivery obligations.
